verify.note: wowsimcli on this request, 180 ± 20 s, 20,000 iterations, seed 1 (2026-11-04, after hotfix 113539)

summary: Keeps 5 Sunder Armor stacks on the boss for a raid with no warrior tank. The raid's Sunder Armor is off.
rotation: Start with 0 Rage. Before the pull, Battle Stance, Charge (15 Rage) and back to Berserker Stance. Battle Shout comes from the raid

Sunder Armor on duty for the raid: 5 stacks from the pull (7.5s of GCDs), before anything but the opening cooldowns, then refreshed in its last 3s, unless it lasts the fight. The raid's Sunder Armor is off

Save Death Wish for the last 33s when that doesn't lose a use. Recklessness goes with the last Death Wish, and the trinket 1 GCD later. In fights with 2 Death Wishes, the first goes at the pull without Recklessness

Blood Fury and Berserking with Death Wish. Elune's Light on cooldown, but never during Recklessness or the 15s before it. Trinket on cooldown, with its last use saved for the last 30s. Mighty Rage Potion in the last 20s, and at the pull too when a second one fits
During execute, Execute comes after Bloodthirst and Whirlwind. Putting it first loses 4.7 DPS on Fury and 22.7 on two-hand Fury
Reckless Swings on cooldown, but only when no strike is ready, since it takes a 1s GCD. The next 4 swings give 5 more Rage each
Heroic Strike at 70+ Rage, during execute too
Hamstring as filler at 10+ Rage (it procs Windfury Totem and Flurry)
caveats: The duty costs 29.0 DPS at 180s against the same build without it (1012.5 against 1041.5, 20,000 iterations, seed 1). Part of it is the ramp: the warrior's own hits meet fewer stacks for the first 7.5s, where the raid's Sunder was full at once.
Assumed: white hits give Rage by weapon speed, at the level 30 rate even at level 60.
No Ahn'Qiraj book ranks, so Heroic Strike stops at rank VIII, and the raid's Battle Shout at VI, Strength of Earth at IV and Grace of Air at II.
Assumed: the crit Rage bonus is for white hits only. Heroic Strike can trigger Unbridled Wrath.
Only one +2% crit elixir. A second (Grizzly) would add 15.1 DPS.
Battlegear of Glory 4-piece isn't counted. It would add 10.8 DPS vs Humanoids.
Saving Death Wish for the last 33s adds 13.3 DPS at 180s and 26.2 at 120s. Saving the trinket for the last 30s adds 2.2 at 180s.
Saving the second Mighty Rage Potion for the last 20s adds 10.4 DPS at 180s and 0.0 at 120s.
Rage from taking raid damage (2 hits a minute, about 9 Rage each) is an estimate.
notes: Request from mksettings with the same arguments as warrior__fury except -apl level60_fury_sunder, then the raid's sunderArmor removed (the duty warrior's Sunder is the only one, as for a raid with no warrior tank). Made as a hand edit of the base request, which is the same. Duties (seed 1, 20,000 iterations): Sunder +3.8 / +2.8 / +1.8 at 120 / 180 / 300 s. Not yet re-verified here.
